summary: A tight, playable teaser beat with a clean escalation: warning, objection, life-or-death rationale, then Shalabi’s clipped acceptance. The technical information comes through urgent operational speech rather than documentary exposition, and the final line gives the beat a strong turn into the smash cut.

lines.speaker: SQUADRON LEADER

performance.delivery: He keys the intercom and gives Shalabi the threat and the unavoidable decision in one professional burst. Keep the voice firm and close to the microphone, never panicked.

lines.text: يَا حَمْدِي… الرَّادَارْ لَاقِطْ تَشْكِيلْ فَانْتُومْ. هَنِضْطَرّْ نِنَزِّلْ الْقُوَّةْ كُلَّهَا فِي أَقْرَبْ مَنْطِقَةْ.

lines.speaker: SHALABI

performance.delivery: He reacts to the mission consequence, not out of fear for himself. Bite down on «يَعْنِي إِيهْ» and tighten further on «الْكَمِينْ» without raising the voice.

lines.text: يَعْنِي إِيهْ يَا فَنْدِمْ؟ دَهْ هَيْبَعِّدْنِي عَنْ الْكَمِينْ.

lines.speaker: SQUADRON LEADER
issues: The line is at the five-second limit; keep the pause after «أَوَصَّلَكْ» brief.

performance.delivery: He cuts off the objection with the concrete cost, speaking over rotor and radio noise. Stress «الطَّيَّارَاتْ» and «وِنِخْسَرْكُو», then make the last sentence a firm statement of duty.

lines.text: لَوْ اِتْضَرَبْنَا وِإِنْتُو جُوَّهْ، هَنِخْسَرْ الطَّيَّارَاتْ وِنِخْسَرْكُو. أَنَا مُهِمِّتِي إِنِّي أَوَصَّلَكْ… وَأَحَافِظْ عَلَى حَيَاتَكْ.

performance.delivery: After looking at his men, he gives the word directly into the headset. It is consent to the pilot’s decision, not an order barked at him; land the final syllable and stop.
